tei:div.tei:p: "$ (469)༄༅// bla med lhan skyes rnam bzhi'i rdzogs rim snying po don gyi phreng ba zhes bya ba bzhugs so// u pa de sha gam+bhi ra/

(470)༄༅// na mo badz+ra gu ru a ti de wa tā ya// 'dir dbang thob cing dam sdom la gnas pa'i slob ma la/ mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i slob dpon gyis lhan skyes rnam pa bzhi'i rdzogs rim zab mo shin tu bsdus pa'i tshul gyis ston pa ni/ rdzogs rim bzhi ga'i sngon 'gro thun mong las dal 'byor rnyed dka' ba/ de mi rtag pa/ las 'bras/ rigs drug gi sdug bsngal rnams dang*/ thun mong ma yin pa/ skyabs 'gro/ sems bskyed/ rdor sems/ maṇ+ḍal/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor rnams spyi 'gro ltar gyis rgyud legs par sbyangs zin nas/ dngos gzhi'i dang po pha rgyud gsang ba 'dus pa mi bskyod pa'i rdzogs rim rdo rje'i phreng ba sogs bshad rgyud chen po brgyad kyi dgongs pa/ 'phags lugs mar mtshur yab sras kyi bzhed srol rim lnga gdan gcig 'khor lo med pa'i lugs shin tu bsdus pa ni/ dang po rdo rje'i bzlas pa'i rim pa ni khyad par gyi sngon 'gro yin te/ lus rnam snang gi chos bdun dang ldan pas/ mtshan bcas rdo rje'i bzlas pa ni/ rang zhe sdang rdo rje dpa' bo gcig par gsal ba'i thugs kar 'od (471)kyi dkyil 'khor me long tsam sgreng ba'i 'dab dbus su thig le dkar po a shad nag pos mtshan pa zhig bsam pa'i ngang nas rlung ro bsal te/ slar sna bug nas rlung rngubs hūm̐ gi rnam par sna sgor thon pa'i tshe hūm̐ de dag sprul pa'i sku dpag tu med par gyur/ 'gro ba'i don byas mi bskyod rdo rje'i go 'phang la bkod/ tshur rngubs pa'i tshe phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras bcas kyi byin rlabs oṃ gyi rnam par rtsa nang nas mar sib sib song bar dmigs nas nang du gnas pa'i tshe āḥyig gi rnam par bsam la ci mang du dmigs so// mtshan med ni/ rang lhar gsal tsam nas rlung sngags dbyer med ma bcos gzhom bral don dam brjod yul las 'das pa rlung nang du rngubs pa oṃ/ gnas pa āḥphyir ro byung ba hūm̐ rnams gdod nas grub pa yin pa la yin pa'i dran shes kyis yun ring du bsgom/

de yang 'byung 'jug gnas gsum yi ge gsum du bcos nas bsgom pa ma yin zhing ngag nas brjod pa yang ma yin gyi de ltar don gyi bzlas pa rlung sems tha mi dad du 'khrul pa'i rjes su mi 'brang bar rtse gcig tu gnas pa ste ma yengs par bsgom dgos pa (472)yin no// sngon 'gro rgyas pa dben gsum sogs gsungs pa yang 'dir 'du'o// de ltar yun ring du sbyangs pas rtsa ba'i rlung lnga 'dus pa'i rtags su/ du ba lta bu ser ljang dang*/ smig rgyu lta bu sngo ljang dang*/ me khyer lta bu dmar ljang dang*/ sgron me lta bu dkar ljang rnams g.yo bzhin pa dang*/ nam mkha' ltar gsal dwangs ngos bzung med pa 'byung*/ de'i tshe phrag dog dag pa bya grub ye shes sangs rgyas don yod grub pa 'char/ gnyis pa sems la dmigs pa yang khyad par gyi sngon 'gro yin// steng 'og gi rlung 'then pa la bzung nas/ rang lhar gsal ba la ma yengs par sems gtad cing rlung bzung ba ni 'byung bzhi'i rlung zin pa yin/ rnam par shes pa snang ba la thim pa ni stong pa'i ye shes kyi skabs te sems zin pa'i rtags rna bar tsam ring ring ba dang*/ lus 'jag ma ltar ldem pa'o// rang lhar gsal ba snying ga'i 'od me long lta bu la thim par dmigs nas 'od dkyil la sems ma yengs par gtad/ rlung bzung bas snang ba mched pa la thim pas stong pa chen po'i ye shes zhe sdang las gyur pa'i rang bzhin sum cu rtsa gsum thim/ rtags zla 'od lta bu skya lam lam pa 'byung*// yang rlung dang bcas 'od kyi me long thig le la bsdus/ thig le la sems ma yengs par bsgoms pas mched pa nyer thob la gnas nas shin tu stong pa'i ye shes 'dod chags las gyur ba'i rang bzhin bzhi bcu thim/ rtags nyi 'od lta bu dmar lam lam ba byung*/ rtags can nam mkha' ltar sngo song sang ba dang gnag ling ling ba 'ong ngo*// yang rlung bcas thig le a thung la bsdus nas a thung la sems ma yengs par bsgoms pas/

nyer thob 'od gsal la thim pas thams cad stong pa'i ye shes ma rig pa las gyur pa'i rang bzhin bdun thim/ rtags mun pa lta bu nag tham (473)tham pa byung*/ rtags can rang lus 'od phung lta bu'i 'od 'phro ba 'byung*/ lar rtags 'di tshe khrags chags kyi nges pa med par go rim 'chol ba'ang 'byung srid/ de rnams ni 'dod chags dag pa sor rtog ye shes sangs rgyas 'od dpag med du 'char ro// de dag ni khyad par gyi sngon 'gro yang yin no// dngos gzhi bden pa gnyis kyi tshul nyams su blang ba la/ kun rdzob kyi bden pa med bzhin tu snang ba sgyu ma lta bu'i tshul bsgom pa'i phyir sgyu lus kyi rim pa ni/ a thung snang la rang bzhin med pa gnag phrig phrig pa shin tu phra ba la sems gtad/ de yang snang la rang bzhin med pa sogs sgyu ma'i dpe bcu gnyis kyis mtshon par bsgom/ yang sgyu ma bzung ba ni/ mdun tu lha sku me long la shar ba la bstod smad byas pas/ dga' sdug sogs 'dug gam mi 'dug blta/ de mi 'dug pa dang lha sku de dmigs pas mdun tu phyung nas de la bstod smad byas pas dga' sdug sogs 'dug gam mi 'dug blta/ mi 'dug na de nyid sgyu ma'i dpe bcu gnyis sogs kyis brtags nas bsgom/ de sgyu ma med bzhin tu snang bar rtogs nas mdun tu lha dmigs pa rang la bstims nas rang lha sku sgyu ma lta bur bsgom/ rang lhar gsal ba la bstod smad dang*/ g.yas nas tsan+dan gyi lde gus byugs pa la dga' zhing chags pa med par/ g.yon nas ste'us gzhog pa la mi 'jigs shing sdang ba med pa sgyu ma lta bur spyad do// de yang dngos po thams cad la rang dbang med par khyab par sgyu ma'i sprul pa lta bu/ gsal la ma 'dres pa 'ja' tshon lta bu/ rlung dang 'od zer las grub pa mig 'khrul lta bu/ gcig la gnyis sam mang por snang yang mig yor lta bu/ gang gis kyang gzhig par mi nus pa grib ma lta bu/

gcig gis kun la khyab pa chu nang gi zla ba lta bu'am ya ma brla lta bu/ yan lag dang nying lag (474)tu snang ba me long nang gi gzugs brnyan lta bu/ gnas yul du snang ba dri za'i grong khyer lta bu/ nyams su myong yang ngo bo med pa rmi lam lta bu/ ro gcig la du mar snang ba chu bur lta bu/ 'phro ba myur ba brag cha lta bu/ 'jug pa myur ba glog lta bu ste sgyu ma'i dpe bcu gnyis kyis mtshon nas tshogs drug thams cad sgyu mar sbyang ba shin tu gal che'o// slar sku bsdus nas a shad snang la rang bzhin med pa/ sgyu ma lta bu la sems gtad nas rlung bzung*/ de'i tshe nam mkha' 'gro ba sogs kyi nyams byung na sgyu ma 'byongs pa'i rnam thar skyes pa yin no// de nas sgyu ma sbyang ba ni/ nyams ci skyes kyang dga' zhing rloms pa med par ngam grogs dang g.yang sa dang chu dang ri brag /me phung sogs la thogs pa med par stong par stong thal thal btang la/ sgyu ma'i rnam thar spel ba sogs bya/ bdag gis bar do'i dus su sgyu ma'i lus kyang sgyu lus su shes shing longs spyod rdzogs pa'i skur lnga dbang bya'o snyam du 'phen pa yang yang btang*/ de ltar nyin mo bsgom/ mtshan mo rmi lam sgyu mar sbyang ba yang gong ltar lhar gsal ba'i thugs ka'i a thung la sems gtad/ rmi lam la rmi lam du shes par bya'o snyam du 'phen pa btang la gnyid log /rmi lam zin pa'i tshe/ rmi lam yin rmi lam sgyu ma yin pas cir yang bsgyur tu gtub bsam pas spel zhing sbyang ba dang bsgyur ba la bslab/ bdag gis rmi lam sgyu ma'i snang ba 'di longs skur ldang bar bya'o snyam nas ldang ba sogs bya/ yang rmi lam bar do yin/ srid pa bar do yang tshul 'di ltar nyams su blang bar bya'o snyam du 'phen pa yang yang btang*/ des ni zhe sdang dag pa me long lta bu'i ye shes sangs rgyas mi bskyod pa yang 'char ro/// /bzhi pa don dam bden pa snang yang ngo bos ma grub par rang bzhin med par 'od gsal gyi rim pa ni/

sgyu mar snang tsam pa'i gnyis snang gi rtog pa de yang 'od (475)gsal stong pa chen po'i mes sbyang ba yin la/ 'di la yang gzhi lam 'bras bu'i 'od gsal gsum/ gzhi'i 'od gsal la yang gzhi'i spyi don gyi 'od gsal ni sems nyid rang bzhin 'od gsal ba nyid yin/ gzhi'i sbas don gyi 'od gsal ni 'chi ba'i tshe nyer thob 'od gsal la thim ma thag brjod med kyi 'od gsal bde ba chen por yud tsam re 'char ba de nyid yin no// de dag gi ngo bor 'tshang rgya ba'i thabs ni/ lam gyi 'od gsal nyams su blang ba ste/ de yang nyin par 'od gsal 'dzin pa'i tshe zhi ba dang drag po gnyis las zhi bar 'dzin pa ni rang lhar gsal ba ril 'dzin nam/ rjes gzhig gi bsam gtan gnyis po gang rung gis stong pa chen por bsdus la sems nam mkha' ltar mtha' dbus med pa/ nyi zla ltar gsal ba/ rgya mtsho ltar dwangs pa/ ri bo ltar g.yo 'gul med par bzhag go /drag por 'dzin na rang lhar wal tsam gsal bas rang ngam grogs kyis rtsa rba rlabs rim gyis btsir pas/ srog 'gogs pa'i tshe 'byung ba bzhi dang snang mched thob gsum thim pa'i rtags man ngag ltar ngos bzung ba'i mthar srog 'gags pa dang lhan cig la skad cig ma'i 'od gsal shi ba'i dus dang cha 'dra ba 'byung ba de la yun ring du 'jog cing*/ tshul de ni shi ba'i tshe yang nyams su blang ba'i man ngag dam pa'o// mtshan mo gnyid mthug gi 'od gsal 'dzin pa yang*/ bla ma spyi bor bsgom/ mdun du yi dam bsgom la 'od gsal zin par gsol ba btab/ dkon mchog gi rten la mchod pa 'bul/ yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong la mi shas brgyan pa'i gtor ma 'bul nas gong ltar gsol ba btab/ dkar me mtshan thub btang*/ sngas byang du bstan seng ge'i nyal stabs byas la bla ma spyi bor bstim/ gnyid 'thug gi gti mug 'od gsal du 'dzin pa'i 'phen pa btang*/ (476)rang lhar gsal ba'i snying gar pad+ma sngon po 'dab ma bzhi pa'i lte bar mi shigs pa'i thig le sngon po 'od 'bar ba la shes pa gtad/

gnyid kyi thim rim ngos bzung*/ gnyid la 'gro ba'i tshe thig le la sems ma yengs par gtad nas gnyid du btang*/ grogs kyis bltas pas dbugs bde/ ngo mdangs gsal na zin pa yin/ de las bzlog na ma zin pa yin pas gnyid sad nas slar 'dzin pa yin/ de'i tshe gnyid log tu ma gtub na stong 'byams yin pas zas bcud can bsten/ smin mtshams su thig le nag po bsgom/ des kyang ma byung na gnyid log dus brla rtsa gnyis cung zad mnan/ gnyid mthug drag po ni dung 'byams yin pas gos srab tu btang*/ rlung bum pa can bzung*/ zin la khad dus gnyid sad nas da 'byams yin pas de'i gnyen por stong 'byams dang 'dra zhing gnyid kyi gegs rnams spang*/ rmi lam kho nas khyer na dred 'byams yin pas/ gong gi thig le de nyid nag por bsgom rlung mi bzung*/ de ltar byas pas gnyid srab mos zin na gnyid du 'gro ba dang lhan cig nyi ma shar ba ltar dwangs shing gsal la blo'i 'dzin pa dang tshogs drug gi der snang cung zad tsam yod pa la de'i 'khrul blo'i rjes su mi 'bral ba 'byung*/ gnyid mthug pos zin na gsal stong nam mkha' lta bu 'dzin med kyi ting nge 'dzin ches brtan pa 'byung*/ de ltar zin nas grogs dang mar me sogs mi dgos par rang nyid kha nas sbyang*/ de la 'bad pas rab tshe 'di/ 'bring 'chi khar 'od gsal ngos zin nas grol bar 'gyur ro// 'chi ba'i tshe gang la yang ma chags pa'i ngos nas bla ma yab yum la 'chi ba lam du slong bar gsol ba btab la thim rim ngos bzung*/ tha ma'i tshe gong gi btsan thabs sam gnyid mthug gi skabs ltar 'dzin/ grogs kyis brda sbyar bas 'chi ba 'od gsal chos skur grol ba gdon mi za'o// zhib cha zhal (477)las dris/ 'di'i rtags sprin med pa'i nam mkha' rkyen gsum dang bral ba lta bu 'byung*/ de ni gti mug dag pa chos dbyings ye shes sangs rgyas rnam par snang mdzad du 'char ro/// /lnga pa zung 'jug gi rim pa ni/

de ltar lam gyi dngos gzhi sgyu lus dang 'od gsal gyi nyams su blang ba yang tha dad ya bral ma yin pa snang phyogs sgyu ma lta bu/ stong phyogs 'od gsal stong nyid zung 'jug nam mkha' lta bu zung 'jug tu nyams su blang ba yin te/ nyin mtshan pa'i dus kyi 'od gsal gang yin kyang stong pa chen po khyab bar la gsal dwangs de'i ngang nas khams gsum thams cad rdo rje 'chang gi skur snang ba'am tshogs drug thams cad ma bsgribs par gsal la der 'dzin med pa stong pa dang snang ba phyogs gcig gang du yang brjod du med pa gnyis su med pa'i nyams 'char ba ni lam dus kyi zung 'jug yin la shi ba dang skad cig ma dang 'od gsal chen por lam gyi tshe chos sku mnyam yangs mtha' gral chen po rang gis ma bsgrubs kyang 'grub la/ de las ma g.yos bzhin tu tshogs drug gi snang cha sgyu ma lta bu dag pa'i snang ba 'ba' zhig tu 'char ba rnams der 'dzin 'khrul blo med par snang stong chu zla lta bur 'char bas zung 'jug longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku skad cig la 'bad pa med par 'grub pa yin no// des ni nga rgyal dag pa mnyam nyid ye shes sangs rgyas rin chen 'byung ldan tu 'char ro// mjug rnams su bsngo bas rgyas btab/ thun mtshams thams cad tshogs drug snang la rang bzhin med pa sems dang sems byung tha dad med cing brjod med bzo bral 'od gsal chen po de'i ngang las rang mdwangs bskyed rim lha sku sgyu ma lta bur nan gyis spyod/ yan lag 'pho ba dang grong 'jug gtum mo sogs nag khrid du shes par bya'o// zhes pa ni pha rgyud gsang ba 'dus pa'i (478)rdzogs rim lam rim pa lnga pa 'khor lo med pa can mdor bsdus pa zab mor gdams pa'i skabs so/// /yang ma rgyud 'khor lo sdom pa'i rdzogs pa'i rim pa grub chen dril bu zhabs kyi dgongs pa ltar nyams su blang ba ni// sngon 'gro rnams gong ltar las/ dngos gzhi'i lam dril bu rim lngar grags pa la yang rim pa dang po dang gnyis pa khyad par gyi sngon 'gro/

gsum pa dngos gzhi/ bzhi pa cha lag /lnga pa ngo sprod kyi tshul du ston che/ dang po yid dag par byed pa rang byin gyis brlab pa'i rim pa la gsum gyi sa bon med pa'i chen po ni/ lus rnam snang gi chos bdun dang ldan pas rang gi sems yul la 'jug pa 'di nyid tshogs drug gi rnam rtog der 'dzin dang bcas la bkag nas rnam par mi rtog pa'i ngang du ci gnas su 'jog pa nyid do// sa bon dang bcas pa ni/ gal te de lta bus sems gnas par ma nus na rang 'khor lo sdom pa yab rkyang du gsal ba'i thugs kar oṃ las zla ba phyed pa sran ma phyed gshag tsam gyi steng mi shigs pa'i thig le yungs 'bru tsam dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs can/ rang bzhin stong pa/ rnam pa gsal ba/ ngo bo zung du 'jug pa la sems gtad la mi spro bar bsgom/ de la sems zin kyang dbang shes yul la 'pho nas/ mig dbang gzugs la 'pho na/ mig tu thig le dkar po// de bzhin tu rna ba sgrar 'pho na thig le nag po/ sna drir 'pho na ser po/ lce ror 'pho na dmar po/ lus reg byar 'pho na rdo rje'i rtser ljang gu rnams gang rung bsgom pa la sems bzung*/ mthar tshogs drug gang la 'pho ba dang*/ de'i dbang shes dbyer med rtsol bral du bsgom mo// sa bon med pa zhes bya ba ni/ rlung sems lhan cig tu 'ching ba ste/ rang gi lus kyi rlung zla nyi zung 'jug gi bdag nyid gsum du gnas pa lus kyi steng du g.yas g.yon mnyam pa gsum/ bar du steng 'og bar gsum/ (479)smad du rtsa gsum gyi dbye ba gsum ste/ thams cad kyang rdo rje gsum du mos nas/ lus gnad snga ma lta bu la lag gnyis pus mo'i steng du sa gnon byas la/ sna bug gang nas rlung rgyu ba de 'jug gnas 'byung gsum ma bcos rang bab la sems bzung*/ rlung de'i kha dog dmar smug gam dmar skya la sems bzung*/ rlung de nyid nang du zhugs tshe lus thams cad khyab par bsgom/ de bzhin tu rlung gi rgyu ba'i phyogs kyi sna bug la sbyar mthar gnyis ka la yang sbyar/

yang steng 'og gi rlung man ngag lta bu bum pa kha sbyor dang*/ logs rlung rgyab rlung gnyis la'ang de ltar sbyar nas bsgom/ mthar gong gi thig le dang rlung stabs gcig la sbyar la bsgom/ des ni lha'i mig sogs thob par byed do/// /gnyis pa rlung dag par byed pa sna tshogs rdo rje'i rim pa la yang sa bon dang bcas pa dang sa bon med pa gnyis las sa bon dang bcas pa ni/ lus gnad gong ltar la/ rlung ro bsal/ steng 'og gi rlung kha sbyor drag pos bzung la/ lus nang 'od kyi rang bzhin can gyi rlung gis gang bar bsam/ spyi bor sna tshogs rdo rje shar dkar/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang*/ lte ba mthing ga'i dbus su a las chos 'byung gi nang du hūm̐ las rdo rje dmar po rtse lnga pa'i lte bar zla ba la hūm̐ dkar la dmar bas mtshan pa la sems gtad/ mthar hūm̐ gi thig le la sems ci gnas su bzhag /de las g.yon lus nang du dhū ti gsal/ rlung gi 'od dhū ti'i nang du mar song bas bde ba skyes par bsam la bsgom/ de bzhin tu gsang gnas su yang sna tshogs rdo rje sogs snga ma lta bu bsgom pa'i rlung 'od phreng du 'gro ba la sems gtad/ yul la sems 'pho na gong du 'pho ba'i mig sogs kyi dbang po sogs kyang sna tshogs rdo rjer bsgom/ de ltar 'bad pas nyi ma skar ma lta bu'i rtags snang 'char/ yang lus gnad gong ltar la (480)sna bug g.yas nas rlung bus/ mdzod spu'i thad du nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la sems gtad/ yang g.yon nas bus nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor de'i steng du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor du gyur pa la sems gtad/ yang gnyis ka nas bus pas zla dkyil gyi dbus su thig le sngon po// shar dkar/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang ba'i thig le lngar gyur par bsam ste/ thig le rnams res mos su sems gtad/ de rnams kyi tshe rlung bus nas nang du mi rngubs par phyir 'dzin la ci thub tu bzung*/

mi thub pa'i tshe nang du rngub/ dmigs pa de nyid rim pa ltar gsang bar bsgom/ de nas mig la sogs pa dbang po'-i sgo rnams su yang bsam/ sems dang yang bsre/ des ni snga ma'i bogs 'don zhing lha'i mig sogs rgyud nas gsungs pa rnams nges par 'thob pa'o// gsum pa nor bu 'gengs pa'i rim pa zhes sam dngos gzhi bsgom pa la dam tshig /las/ chos/ phyag rgya chen po dang bzhi las/ dang po dam tshig gi phyag rgya ni/ lus rnam snang chos bdun dang ldan pas/ rang 'khor lo sdom par gsal ba'i pang du yum rdo rje rnal 'byor mar gsal btab pa'i yum gyi mkha' gsang sgrub thabs ltar byin gyis brlabs rjes/ rang gi lte bar oṃ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ snying gar oṃ sarba bud+dha ḍā ki nī ye badz+ra bar+kha nī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ mgrin par oṃ shrī badz+ra he he ru ru kaṃ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa ḍā ki nī dz+wa la sam+ba raṃ swā hā/ dpral bar oṃ hriḥha ha huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ yum gyi lte bar oṃ shrī badz+ra= snying gar oṃ hriḥha= mgrin par oṃ badz+ra bai ro= dpral bar oṃ sarba bud+dha= de ltar gsal btab nas 'du shes gsum ldan gyis snyoms par zhugs pa byang sems spyi bo nas mgrin par slebs pa dga' ba/ snying gar mchog dga'/ lte bar dga' bral/ gsang bar lhan skyes rnams so sor mnyam par bzhag /nor bu'i rtse mor son pa dang ldog pa gsum gyi (481)sbyor bas hūm̐ zhes yar bzlog pas lte bar dga' ba/ snying gar mchog dga'/ mgrin par dga' bral/ spyi bor lhan skyes la mnyam par bzhag /dmigs pa rno bas kun+da 'pho bar nye na lag gnyis khu tshur bcangs pa snying gar bsnol/ mig gnyis gyen tu ldog /lce ya rkan la sbyar/ hri zhes rlung sems gyen tu 'then la byang sems dhū ti'i nang du yar 'phos pas spyi bo'i haṃ la thim par bsam mo// las kyi phyag rgya ni/ pad+ma can sogs bsten byar 'os pa drang nges kyi chos bshad pas blo bcos/

dbang gis smin par byas nas tshul dang mthun pa'i gnas su rang dang rig ma 'khor lo sdom pa yab yum du bskyed pa'i mkha' gsang byin gyis brlabs nas so sor sngags rnams bgod nas/ brda dang kyi sbyor bas 'du shes gsum ldan gyis snyoms 'jug bya/ byang sems phab cing dga' bzhi'i ye shes la mnyam par bzhag /'phor nye ba'i tshe/ rab ting nge 'dzin/ 'bring dmigs lugs/ tha ma 'phrul 'khor gyi sgo nas dbab 'dzin zlog 'dren sogs dgram rtsa mig tu gdab par bya zhing 'phrul 'khor dgos pa byung na rung mthun gzhan nas kha skong du rung ngo*// zhi ba cha zhal du gab bo// chos kyi phyag rgya ni/ bshad ma thag pa'i yid rig dang dngos rig gang yin yang snyoms 'jug gi bya ba byas zin ma thag rig pa hūm̐ dmar skyar gyur pa rang gi rdo rje'i lam nas rgyu ba skad cig gis thur sel rlung glog gi zhags pa lta bus bkug cing drangs pa gsang lta snying mgrin dpral bar slebs pa'i tshe/ dga' bzhi so sor sems bzung mthar spyi bo'i haṃ la bstim dmigs med du bzhag /slar tshogs drug gi yul snang gang shar ba bde stong lhan skyes kyi myong ba dang bsre/ rang bab bcos min gyi nyams bzo med gcer yan du skyong*/ phyag rgya chen po ni sems gsal stong zung 'jug /lam bde stong lhan skyes (482)kyi gdams pa/ rnam par mi rtog pa zung 'jug lhan skyes kyi bsam du med pa'i ngo bor bzhag cing*/ de'i rtsal snang rnams kyang nyi ma dang 'od zer ltar gcig yin tha dad min pa'i ngo bor bzo med du bsgoms pas du sogs rnam kun mchog ldan gyi stong pa nyid 'char zhing de la goms par bya'o/// /bzhi pa dza lan+dha ra'i rim pa zhes grol lam pa'i dbang du mdzad pa lam gyi cha lag ni/ lus rnam snang gi chos bdun ltar la lag pa g.yas g.yon bsnol nas dpung pa'i bar lhu 'jus te/ rang gi lte ba'i 'og sor bzhir chos 'byung phyi dkar nang dmar ba'i dbus su thig le sngon po/

mdun tu dkar po/ g.yas su ser po/ rgyab tu dmar po/ g.yon du ljang gu rnams bsgom/ rlung ro bsal nas srog thur gyi rlung bum pa can kha sbyor byas pas/ thig le so so las gtum mo'i me rang rang gi mdog can shin tu phra zhing rno ba 'bar ba la sems rtse gcig tu gtad/ de la goms nas/ me rnams cher 'bar ba'i 'od 'dres pa sna bug g.yas nas phyir thon/ phyogs thams cad du 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams mtha' yas pa na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyi shangs bug g.yas su zhugs nas/ sku'i dbyibs brgyud lte bar song nas gyen tu 'bar nas de dag gi sku'i lte ba/ thugs ka mgrin pa/ spyi bo'i gnas rnams bsregs te byang chub kyi sems dkar dmar rnams spyan drangs nas shangs bug g.yon pa nas thon/ rang gi sna bug g.yon tu zhugs nas spyi bor song dhu ti'i nang brgyud/ lte ba'i me lnga la 'dres pas bde drod gsal stong zung 'jug gi nyams tshad med pa skyes/ slar rang gi lte ba'i me lnga cher 'bar ba rgyal ba 'khor bcas kyi byang chub sems dang tha mi dad pas rang gi spyi bo nas rkang mthil yan chad bar med gang ba la sems gtad/ srog thur bum can tu bzung*/ 'di la goms pas lte ba (483)sogs gnas gang du byang sems brtan pa de dag gi yon tan rgyud nas ji skad gsungs pa ltar 'byung bas na nan tan du bsgom pa gal che'o/// /lnga pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rim pa zhes pa ngo 'phrod nas nyams myong bskyang ba yin te/ tshogs drug gi yul snang gang shar ba de nyid bcos min gyi sems mi shig pa'i ming can dang ro mnyam par byas te/ de yang sems tshogs drug gi phyir ma 'brang*/ tshogs drug sems kyi yul du ma 'dres/ de'i rjes su ma 'brangs par snang la rang bzhin med pa sgyu ma'i dpe ltar nyams su myong pa nyid yul du bsgoms pas snang sems zung du 'jug par 'gyur to// sna tshogs su snang ba ji snyed pa de snyed rang rig bde ba chen po dang tha dad med par 'char ba 'byung ba/

gal te goms 'dris chung ba sogs kyis de ltar snang sems tha dad du mnyam par 'jog tu ma nus na/ brtan g.yo tshogs drug gi snang ba thams cad rang lhar gsal ba la bsdu/ de yang thugs ka'i hūm̐ la bsdus la nā da'i bar du bsdus nas/ nā da yang je phrar gyur pa ci yang mi dmigs pa'i ngang du ci gnas su ma bcos sam lhug pa rang babs su bzhag nas rim gyis snga ma ltar ro mnyam du nges la bsgom par bya'o// thun mtshams rnams su bsngo bas rgyas gdab cing dus thams cad du bsgoms pas rab tshe 'dir mchog gi grub pa thob/ 'bring shi ba'i tshe 'od gsal chos kyi skur 'tshang rgya/ tha mas kyang bar dor dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rnams kyis bsus te 'og min bde ba chen po'i zhing khams su longs sku nges pa lnga ldan tu 'tshang mi rgya ba mi srid pa'i gdams pa dril bu rim lngar grags pa chad pa'i skyon med shin tu bsdus par bgyis pa'i skabs so/// /yang snying po dgyes pa rdo rje'i rdzogs pa'i rim pa grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po nā ro pa'i gdams pa chos drug tu grags pa nyams su (484)blang ba yang*/ sngon 'gro sngar ltar la/ khyad par gyi sngon 'gro rtsa rlung thig le sbyang ba gsum las/ rtsa sbyang ba ni/ rang dgyes pa rdo rje dpa' bo gcig par gsal ba'i spyi bo nas gsang gnas bar du rtsa dbu ma pad+ma rā ga'i mdog lta bu/ g.yas su ro ma dmar mo/ g.yon du rkyang ma dkar po gnyis yas sna klad rgya'i steng nas sna bug gnyis su zug pa/ mas sna yi ge cha ltar gnas nas dbu ma'i steng du tshud pa lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lo rtsa 'dab drug cu rtsa bzhir gyes pa/ snying ga chos kyi 'khor lo 'dab ma brgyad/ mgrin pa longs spyod kyi 'khor lo 'dab ma bcu drug /spyi bo bde chen gyi 'khor lo 'dab ma so gnyis pa/ rtsa gsum 'khor lo bzhi rnams drang ba/ phra ba rkyang ma ma gtogs dmar ba/ gsal ba ste mtshan nyid bzhi ldan du bsam mo// rlung sbyang ba ni/

lus bsam gtan gyi chos drug dang lag pa rdo rje khu tshur pus steng so sor bzhag nas 'bud pa dgu phrugs byas la phyir bus pa'i tshe sdig sgrib thams cad sang sang dag /nang du rngubs pa'i tshe sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad kyi byin rlabs bsdus par bsam/ de nas sgra med du sna bug gnyis nas dal bus rngubs/ mchil ma zhig dang mnyam du lte 'og tu hril gyis dgang*/ de'i tshe rgyab rlung yar bsdams la bum can ci thub bzung*/ mi thub la nye ba'i tshe lus g.yas g.yon tu cung nem nem gyis rtsa mig tu gzhil la bzung*/ mi thub pa'i tshe cung zad phyir btang la mnan nas bzung dal bus sangs kyis sna bug nas btang la mjug tu dbyings rig bsre/ rlung rngubs pa dang btang ba mtha' dag kha nas ma song ba shin tu gal che/ thig le sbyang ba ni/ smin mtshams su thig le sngon po sran ma tsam zhig gnas pa rlung rngubs pa'i tshe dbu ma'i nang nas gsang ba'i bar 'gro/ dgang zhing gzhil ba'i tshe rtsa 'khor rnams su sing sgra dang bcas myur par rgyu/ rlung btang ba'i tshe phyir bton par bsam mo// skabs (485)'dir spro na nā ro drug skor lag len ltar bya/ da ltar rtsa rlung thig le'i lam 'byongs nas/ dngos gzhi nyams su blang ba ni/ rtsa ba'i chos bzhi dang*/ yan lag gi chos gnyis las/ dang po 'dzag bcas 'jig rten pa'i lhan skyes kyi gnyen por gtum mo lam gyi gzhung shing nyams su blang ba ni/ rkang pa tsog bur bsnol/ lag pa mnyam bzhag pus 'khyud/ gzhan bsam gtan gyi yan lag drug po 'dra/ rab gnas dang ldan pa'i sgom thag gis bcing*/ skyabs sems dang bla ma'i rnal 'byor gsal btab/ tsaṇ+ḍa lī'i don nyams su myong bar gsol ba btab/ rang la bstim/ nyams len gyi thog ma gtum mo ma zin pa 'dzin pa ni/ rtsa gsum 'dus mdor lte 'og sor bzhi'i ro rkyang gi sne mo'i steng du chos 'byung dmar po'i dbus su gtum mo a shad kyi rnam pa'i rang bzhin sra zhing gzhom gzhig dang bral ba/

chu dang dmar cha'i dwangs ma rlon zhing gsher ba/ me'i rang bzhin rno zhing tsha ba sreg pa'i ngar can/ rlung gi rang bzhin g.yo zhing kun tu khyab pa/ gzhan yang kha dog dmar ba/ reg bya tsha ba/ ngo bo bde ba/ rtse mo rno zhing 'khyog pa'i rnam pa can du bsam mo// zin pa brtan par bya ba ni/ nam mkha'i rlung zhes mnyam rgyu'i skabs sbyong ba'i skabs ltar bum can mtshan nyid bzhi ldan du bzung ba'i tshe ro rkyang nas srog rtsol gyi sbud pas a shad la bsnun ma thag de las me cher bus nas dbu ma'i nang du 'bar ba'i me lce yang gong ltar mtshan nyid bzhi ldan tu mnyam par bzhag go /brtan pa bogs 'don pa la/ drod bde ba/ mi rtog pa gsum las/ drod bogs 'don ni/ gong ltar rlung bzung bas me ches cher 'bar bas rtsa gsum 'khor lo bzhi lus kyi phyi nang thams cad la mes gang bar bsam/ spro na drod kyi 'phrul 'khor bya/ lus rngul na sran (486)phyes 'phur ba sogs man ngag ltar dang so bdun ma'i 'phrul 'khor bya'o// yang rlung bzung bas me ches cher 'bar bas stong gsum me lce gcig tu 'bar bar bsam mo// 'di'i skabs su gtum mo bde drod kyi lang tsho dam zhing gos kyi 'khri ba gcod pa'i phyir ras 'bud bya ba ni/ rab lta ba gnyis med zung 'jug rtogs pa/ 'bring dmigs pa yul gang la rang dbang chub pa/ tha mas ni 'di ltar khrus bya/ bgegs bskrad/ srung 'khor bsgom/ shis brjod bya/ dmigs pa mal stan me'i dkyil 'khor/ gru gsum 'bar ba'i steng du rang lus lcags bsregs pa lta bu/ lag gnyis g.yas 'og /g.yon steng nyi dkyil me 'bar bar bsam/ snod bcud kyi me rnams bsdus pa lte 'og sor bzhir bya sgong tsam la sems gtad/ ras rkyang gi bgo bas seng ge'i nyal stabs su mgo byang du bstan la bde bar nyal/ dros dka' na rje btsun rat+na'i dag pa'i snang ba gtum mo tsaṇ+ḍa lī'i dmigs pa bcu bzhi 'phul gcig gis 'phrul 'khor dang bcas pa bla ma'i zhal rgyun ltar bya/

chu ras sogs kyang skabs su bab na bya ba yin no// bde ba bogs 'don pa ni lus gnad rtsa gsum 'khor lo bzhi gtum mo rnams sngar ltar la/ snying gar dbus su bh+rum̐/ phyogs bzhir oṃ dz+rīṃ khaṃ hūm̐/ mgrin par dbus su maṃ/ phyogs bzhir lāṃ pāṃ tāṃ āṃ rnams rtsa mdud kyi rnam pa/ spyi bor dkar cha'i dwangs ma haṃ yig mgo thur bstan du yod par bsam/ rlung bzung bas a shad las me 'bar bas g.yon rkyang ma zla ba'i rgyu ba bkag g.yas ro ma'i nang du 'bar bas snying ga'i rtsa mdud lnga bo dkrol/ mes g.yas ro ma nyi ma'i rgyu ba bkag /g.yon rkyang ma'i nang du 'bar bas mgrin pa'i rtsa mdud lnga po dkrol/ me lces g.yas g.yon ro rkyang nyi zla'i rgyu ba bkag /dbu ma'i nang du mar babs a shad la (487)thim la khad sor bzhi tsam 'bar ba la sems gtad/ yang rlung bzung bas sbud nas me cher 'bar/ dbu ma'i nang brgyud 'khor lo bzhi rim gyis bgrod pas/ haṃ la reg pa'i tshe haṃ las dkar cha skya shar gyis babs pa/ me lo la reg la khyad du nye ba na je dma' dang dkar cha je ring du 'phros ded byas nas thur du bab pa'i tshe mgrin par byang sems slebs pa dga' ba/ snying gar mchog dga'/ lte bar dga' bral/ gsang bar lhan skyes la mnyam par bzhag /yang rlung gi sbyor bas a shad la me 'bar ba'i che me je ring dang*/ dkar cha je thung gyen la 'dzeg pa'i tshe lte bar dga' ba/ snying gar mchog dga'/ mgrin par dga' bral/ spyi bor lhan skyes la mnyam par bzhag /'di'i skabs bde ba 'bar bas byang sems 'phor nyen gsum chos kyi gnad ni/ bde nyams nyon mongs kyi rtog pa tsir gyis bzung gzhu bdungs pa'i yun tsam lam du btang*/ slar sher snying klog pa'i yun tsam de'i ngo bor bltas la gnad du dbab/ de nas byang chub kyi sems yud tsam bsgoms pas dug la sngags btab pas sman tu 'gyur ba ltar byang chub sems gnyis dang bde ba ro gcig tu gyur te gnas skabs su sangs rgyas byang sems mang po'i zhal mthong zhing mthar thug 'dod chags dag pa pad+ma rigs su 'tshang rgya ba'i dgos pa yod/

de rjes lus lhar gsal btab ba spu'i khung bu tshun khrem par bkram pas yon tan dang dngos grub thams cad myur du thob par 'gyur bar gsungs so// rkang pa 'gum pa sogs byung na gtum mo sku bsring ba man ngag ltar bya'o// gzhan yang rje rin po che'i man ngag ni/ lte 'og rtsa gsum 'dus mdor thig le dkar zhing dmar la mdangs chags pa snum la 'dril ba bde ba'i rang bzhin bya sgong tsam zhig bsgom/ de la goms nas de 'dab brgyad dang bcu drug tu gyes (488)par bsgom/ de la goms nas de 'dra ba dpag tu med par gyes par yang bsgom/ mthar thig le thams cad rtsa ba'i thig le la thim par bsam pas bde drod mi bzod par 'byung bar gsungs so// 'di'i tshe drod shas chung na drod bogs 'don/ bde ba shas chung na bde ba bogs 'don sogs skabs su gang bab brtson par bya'o// mi rtog pa bogs 'don pa ni/ rang lhar gsal ba rjes gzhig gam ril 'dzin gyis bsdus nas rtsa gsum 'khor lo bzhi sogs kyang mi dmigs par gang shar 'dzin med gnyen po drod 'dzin gyi bcos bslad med par gcer yan du bde stong lhan skyes kyi ngo bor 'dzin med yengs med du bskyar ro// de ltar rtsa rlung thig le la gnad du bsnun pas rtsa thams cad rlung dang thig les khyab cing*/ bde drod mi rtog pa'i ye shes myur du rgyud la skye bar 'gyur ro// gtum mo'i dam tshig tu rkang rjen mi bya/ dung mi 'bud/ chu mi brgal/ 'khyag pa yid la mi bya/ lan tsha sgog bca' rul gsum can gyi zas dang tsha skyur gyi btung ba spang ngo*// bde drod kyi gegs su gyur pa rnams la 'dzem mo// de ltar lta ba sprul pa'i 'khor lo la bsten nas gtum mo la gnad du bsnun pas 'pho ba'i gnas skabs kyi dri ma dag nas don dam ye shes rdo rje'i skur 'tshang rgya ba yin no// gnyis pa sems rang bzhin gyis rmongs pa'i gnyen por 'od gsal lam gyi sgron me nyams su blang ba ni dben par mtshams bcad khrus dang bkum nya bya/

grib la 'dzem/ zas bcud can bsten/ lus ngag yid gsum rnam g.yeng spang la/ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong la gtor ma 'bul/ 'od gsal zin pa'i grogs bcol/ zhag gsum gnyid spang*/ nyin par dang srod la gtum mo bsgom/ nam gung dang tho rangs la bab pa'i tshe lus lhar bsgom pa'i nang du rtsa gsum 'khor lo bzhi gsal btab// spyi bor bla ma'i rnal 'byor bsgom nas bdag do (489)nub rmi lam 'od gsal zin pa'i gsol ba btab/ rang la bsdu/ rang gi snying ga chos kyi 'khor lo'i dbus su dbu ma'i nang du pad+ma sngon po 'dab ma bzhi pa'i lte ba'i nyi ma'i steng du bla ma rdo rje 'chang sku chung la dod cing gsal la rang bzhin med pa 'od 'phro ba'i 'od kyis lus phyi nang med pa gang ste shel bum gyi nang du mar me bcug pa lta bur bsam pa'i ngang nas bla ma'i sku la sems ma yengs par gtad la 'jam rlung bum pa can bzung nas/ mgo byang du lta bas seng ge'i nyal stabs kyis nyal/ rnam rtog 'phro na lus snang thams cad 'od kyi rnam par bsdus nas bla ma'i sku la bstim/ des zin/ yang na bla ma'i thugs kar pad+ma sngon po 'dab ma bzhi pa'i lte bar hūm̐ mthing ga 'od 'phro ba la sems gtad/ gzhan gong dang 'dra/ yang na bla ma'i thugs kar pad+ma'i lte bar 'od kyi thig le sngon po yungs 'bru tsam la sems gtad la bsgom mo// de ltar 'bad pas cis kyang zin par 'gyur ro// 'od gsal zin nas bogs 'don pa ni/ thog mar 'od gsal ngos bzung ste/ gzhi'i 'od gsal ni sems rang bzhin 'od gsal ba nyid do// lam gyi 'od gsal la nyams dang rtogs pa gnyis te/ nyams kyi 'od gsal ni gnyid kyi ngang las rnam rtog cher med pa lus phyi nang gnas khang yo byad sogs mthong ba'i nyi ma shar ba lta bu stong nyid kyi gzugs tsam po ba mthong ba'o// rtogs pa'i 'od gsal ni gnyid kyi snang mched thob gsum ngos zin pa'i mthar nyer thob 'od gsal thim ma thag gnyid ma thug med pa 'od gsal nam mkha' lta bu gsal dwangs zung 'jug tu 'char ba yin no// 'bras bu'i 'od gsal la/

spyi don gyi 'od gsal ni/ sangs rgyas pa'i thugs zab gsal gnyis med kyi 'od gsal de nyid yin la/ sbas don 'od gsal ni/ 'chi ba'i thim rim gyi tha mar 'chi ba 'od gsal chos skur 'tshang rgya ba (490)de nyid yin no// de nyid nyams myong gis bogs dbyung ba ni/ nyin par gtum mo bsgom/ de'i nyams myong bde drod kyi ting nge 'dzin gyi rang bzhin spros bral du rtogs pa de dang mtshan mo'i gnyid 'od gsal zung 'jug tu bsgom/ yang mtshan mo'i 'od gsal des nyin snang gi dge sbyor la rgyas btab ste bsgom pa sogs bla ma'i man ngag gi gnad dang sbyor ba yin no// de ltar snying ga chos kyi 'khor lo la bsten nas 'od gsal gnad du bsnun pas gnyid mthug gti mug gnas skabs kyi dri ma dag nas rab tshe 'dir tha mas kyang 'chi ba 'od gsal lam du bslangs nas chos kyi skur 'tshang rgya ba yin no// gsum pa bag chags nying 'khrul gyi gnyen por rmi lam lam gyi tshod 'dzin nyams su blang ba la yang*/ sbyor chos 'od gsal dang 'dra ba la 'dus byas thams cad mi rtag pas gang gis kyang dgos la med snyam pa rtag tu bsam zhing ngag tu yang brjod/ nyin par gtum mo bsgom zhing de'i rjes thob nyin snang thams cad rmi lam yin snyam du sbyang*/ de nas 'dzin pa dngos ni/ rang lhar gsal ba'i spyi bor bla ma bsgom/ mchod nas rmi lam zin par gsol ba btab/ rang la bstim/ srog thur gyi rlung bum can gsum bzung*/ do nub rmi lam du shes par bya snyam pa byas la/ rang lhar gsal ba'i nang du rtsa gsum 'khor lo bzhir gsal ba'i mgrin pa'i rtsa 'dab kyi dbus dbu ma'i nang du gdan bzhi brtsegs kyi steng du bla ma rdo rje 'chang 'od 'phro ba gsal ba'i bla mas kyang*/ chos thams cad rmi lam yin zhes gsung bzhin pa bla ma'i mgrin par pad+ma sngon po 'dab ma bzhi pa'i lte bar oṃ dkar po/ mdun gyi 'dab mar a sngon po/

g.yas su nu ser po/ rgyab tu ta dmar po/ g.yon tu ra ljang gu bsam/ seng ge'i nyal stabs kyis mgo byang du bstan/ 'jam rlung bum pa can bdun bzung la thog mar mdun (491)gyi a la sems gtad/ gnyid bro ba'i tshe nu la sems gtad/ cher bro ba'i tshe ta/ ches cher 'thim pa'i tshe ra dang*/ gnyid du 'gro khar oṃ la ma yengs par gtad/ rtog pa gzhan gyis bar ma chod par sems gtad nas gnyid pas zin par 'gyur ro// des ma zin na rang lhar gsal ba'i smin mtshams su zla dkyil thig le dkar po sran ma tsam gyis mtshan pa la sems bzung*/ des kyang ma zin na rang gi 'og tu thig le dmar po dang steng du dkar po gnyis gsal ba chu nang du rdo bskyur ba'i ri mo ltar je cher song nas gwa'u lta bur gyur pa'i nang du gnas par bsam/ 'di rnams la 'jam rlung dang lus gnad sogs snga ma ltar bya'o// de ltar byas pas rmi lam zin pa'i rtags ni/ rmi lam bzang ngan gang rmis thams cad rmi lam du 'dug snyam ngos tsir tsir zin pa de ga yin no// rmi lam zin 'phro sad na nyin snang du thun mthar sad par mi bya'o snyam pa'i 'dun pa btang*/ nyal ba'i tshe nor bu'i rtser thig le nag po sran ma tsam la sems gtad/ rlung bum can nyer gcig bya/ yang rmi lam re gnyis tsam zin nas gzhan nying 'khrul du song na nyin mo ci nas kyang ma 'khrul bar bya snyam du bsam/ rmi lam zin ma thag 'jam rlung bum can 'dzin par bya'o// zin cing brtan par gyur nas sbyang ba ni/ 'di rmi lam yin pas ji ltar byas kyang btub snyam du bsam nas nyi zlar zhon nas dga' ldan du 'gro ba dang*/ dag pa'i zhing gzhan dang rigs drug gi gnas blta ba sogs su 'gro ba dang*/ dag pa'i zhing du rgyal ba rnams mjal zhing chos nyan pa sogs rnam pa sna tshogs la bslab bo// 'byongs nas spel ba ni/ rmi lam gyi snang ba de dag la gcig las du mar spel ba dang*/ du ma gcig tu bsgyur ba la bslab/

de goms nas bsgyur ba ni/ rmi lam gyi (492)brtan g.yo rnams bla mar bsgyur nas chos zhu ba dang*/ yi dam du bsgyur nas dngos grub blang ba sogs bya'o// de goms nas yang ba spang zhing sgyu mar bslab pa ni/ rmi lam de thams cad ni snang la rang bzhin med pa sgyu mar sbyang zhing*/ mchu g.yang sar mchong ba dang*/ nam mkha' la 'phur ba dang*/ mi phod pa thams cad thog brdzis bya'o// rmi lam gyi de kho na nyid ni/ nyin snang thams cad rmi lam lta bu/ rmi lam yang nyin snang lta bu/ de thams cad rang sems kyi cho 'phrul 'ba' zhig tu shes shing rtogs par byas nas nyin mtshan gyi yul snang thams cad sgyu ma lta bur go bas sems mi rtog pa don dam mchog gi gtum mo las rnam pa kun tu mi g.yo bar ting nge 'dzin gyis dus 'da' bar bya'o// de ltar mgrin pa longs spyod kyi 'khor lo la brten nas rmi lam la gnad du bsnun pas bag chags nying 'khrul gyi gnas skabs kyi dri ma dag nas longs sku nges pa lnga ldan tu 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur ro// bzhi ba snang ba bden 'dzin gyi gnyen por sgyu lus lam gyi gzhi ma nyams su blang ba ni/ gnas dben par dkon mchog gsum dang bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong la mchod gtor phul nas/ chos thams cad sgyu ma lta bur myur du rtogs par gsol ba btab/ mtshams bcad nas thog mar ma dag pa'i sgyu lus sgyu mar sbyang ba la/ lus sgyu mar sbyang ba ni/ rang gi mdun du shing khru gang par me long dri bral btags pa'i nang du rang gi bzhin ras shar ba la bltas nas/ res bstod res smad pas de la dga' dang mi dga' ba'i snang ba ci 'dug pa lta/ ris 'ga' bzhin ras de me long las byung ngam bzhin las byung*/ me long las byung na ni bzhin ras sbas pa'i tshe bzhin ras me long du mi snang*/ bzhin ras las byung na ni me long med na mdun gyi bzhin ras mi snang bas ji ltar yin brtags/

(493)'on te yul yul can tshogs pa las med bzhin tu snang bar sbyang*/ de la sogs pa tshul du mas sbyang zhing*/ de yang sgyu ma'i dpe bcu gnyis las dpe'i gtso bo med bzhin du snang ba me long gi gzugs brnyan lta bu/ rgyu kun tshogs pa las snang yang rang bzhin ma grub pa nam mkha'i 'ja' lta bu/ gcig las du mar snang zhing ngos bzung dang bral ba chu nang gi zla ba lta bu ste/ dpe'i gtso bo gsum gyis mtshon nas shes par bya zhing sbyang*/ ngag sgyu mar bslab pa ni/ brag dben pa'i rtsa bar phyin nas bos shing lab pa'i tshe/ rang gis ji ltar smras pa nyid de las sgra che zhing gsal bar tshur smra ba ltar snang yang*/ de ni brag cha las kyang ma byung*/ rang kho na'i ngag las kyang ma byung bar med bzhin tu smra ba/ smras ma thog tu stong pa'i rang sgra/ grags pa tsam nas ngo bos stong pa/ sgyu ma mkhan gyis sprul pa'i mis tshig brjod pa'am/ rmi lam gyi ngag ltar grags stong sgyu mar sbyang zhing bslab bo// sems sgyu mar bslab pa ni/ dper na nam mkha' 'di rgyu rkyen gang gis kyang ma skyes/ bar du gang du yang mi gnas/ mthar gang du yang mi 'gags/ nam mkha' zhes ming tsam yang ngo bo stong zhing rnam pa gsal ba kha dog sngon po sogs lhun po'i phyogs kyi mdog gis bsgyur bas gang du yang bsgyur du btub pa/ sprin la sogs pa sna tshogs pa'i snang ba ltar 'dug kyang ngo bo la 'gyur ba med pa gsal zhing tsam nas stong pa/ stong tsam nas gsal zhing snang ba/ de gnyis kyang rgyu tha mi dad par zung du 'jug pa ltar rang sems kyang ngo bo ngos bzung dang bral ba/ sems byung rnam rtog sna tshogs 'phro yang sems las logs su ma grub pa tshogs drug gi snang yul du ma snang yang rang rang gi ngo bos stong pa sems las gzhan du med pa dper na sgyu ma mkhan gyi rta (494)glang shing rta brtan g.yo thams cad ji snyed cig sprul yang 'khrul ngor med bzhin du snang yang rtsa ba sgyu ma mkhan rang nyid kyis byas pa ma gtogs gzhan gang yang med pa sogs dpe du mas mtshon nas sems snang thams cad sgyu mar sbyang*/

'byongs nas nyin mtshan gyi snang ba tshogs drug la sogs pa 'khor 'das kyi chos dang chos can thams cad sgyu ma'i dpes mtshon nas sgyu ma'i rnam par thar pa nyid du sbyang bar bya'o// dag pa'i sgyu lus sgyu mar sbyang ba ni/ rang gi rgyab tu lha'i sku dang zhal phyag gyang logs la gzhal yas khang gi nang du yod pa bris pa zhig bsham/ de 'char ba'i me long mdun tu bzhag /gyang logs med na mdun tu bris sku bkram/ de'i gzugs de rang gi rgyab tu me long che ba zhig la 'char bar bya/ de'i gzugs me long la 'char bar byas la/ gang ltar de'i snang brnyan rten dang brten par bcas pa med bzhin snang ba me long gi gzugs brnyan lta bu/ kha dog gsal yang ngo bos ma grub pa 'ja' tshon lta bu/ du mar khyab kyang chu zla lta bu sogs sgyu ma'i dpes mtshon nas sgyu ma lta bur bsam zhing sbyang*/ thun mtshams sogs thams cad du gzugs su snang ba thams cad lha'i sku gsal stong sgyu ma lta bu/ sgra grags pa thams cad sngags kyi rang sgra grags stong sgyu ma lta bu/ sems kyi dran rtog thams cad thugs ting nge 'dzin gsal stong sgyu ma lta bur bslab cing sbyangs pas chos thams cad rang bzhin med pa zhes bya ba gang zag dang chos kyi bdag med gcig dang du ma bral ba sogs lung rigs rtog brtag tha snyad mkhan po'i 'khrul rloms cal sgrog la ltos mi dgos par snang srid sgyu ma lta bur shar bas snang sems tha dad med par rtogs par 'gyur ba yin no// de ltar spyi bo'i bde chen 'khor lo la brten nas sgyu lus la gnad du bsnun (495)pas sad pa'i gnas skabs kyi dri ma dag nas sprul pa'i skur 'tshang rgya ba yin no// lnga pa dang drug pa las rgya myur lam pho nya'i lam gong du 'pho ba dang*/ bar do'i gdams pa gnyis las/ thog mar lam gyi bsu skyel 'pho ba'i gdams pa ni gsum/ dbang po rab kyis gnyis snang chos thams cad rjes gzhig dang ril 'dzin gyis stong pa bzhir bsdus pa'i tha ma 'od gsal ba dang btsan thabs rdo rje/

rba rlabs bcing ba'i sbyor bas srog rtsol 'gags pa'i thim rim ngos bzung ba'i mthar gnyid mthug gi 'od gsal goms 'dris byas pa dag gis 'chi ba'i dus la babs pa'i tshe/ rags pa dang phra ba shin tu phra ba'i thim rim ngos bzung nas 'chi ba'i 'od gsal shar ma thag ngos bzung nas de dang sbyangs pa'i 'od gsal tha mi dad du rtogs pas bar do brgyud ma dgos par skad cig ma dang por chos kyi skur 'tshang rgya'o// dbang po 'bring gis nyin snang 'od gsal stong pa nyid las lha'i skur ldang ba dang*/ btsan thabs rba rlabs bcing nas srog 'gags pa'i 'od gsal gyi ngang nas srog rtsol cung zad rgyu bas rnam rtog phra ba nas ldang ba'i tshe lha'i skur bsgom zhing*/ gnyid kyi 'od gsal kho nar gnas ma thub pas rlung g.yos pas rmi lam gyi 'khrul pa cung zad 'go rtsom pa'i tshe de nyid rmi lam du shes nas sprul bsgyur gyi gdams pas lha skur ldang ba la goms pas/ 'chi ba'i 'od gsal ngos bzung nas snang mched thob pa 'od gsal las rlung dang bsdong nas g.yo zhing ldang bar nye ba'i tshe/ lha sku sgyu ma lta bur skad cig la shar nas longs spyod rdzogs pa'i skur 'tshang rgya ba yin no// dbang po tha ma 'od gsal dang sgyu lus gnyis ka la bsgom blo byas kyang brtan pa ma thob pa dag ni sprul skur 'pho bas mtshams sbyor ba ste 'di la sbyang ba dang las la sbyor ba gnyis (496)las/ sbyang ba ni/ gnas dben par rnam snang gi chos bdun dang ldan pas spyi bor bla ma bsgom/ 'pho ba'i lam 'byongs par gsol ba btab rang la bstim/ rang yi dam du gsal ba'i khong par spyi bo nas gsang gnas bar rtsa dbu ma ka ba btsugs pa lta bu'i lte ba'i thad kyi nang du āḥdamar po/ snying gar sems kyi ngo bo hūm̐ nag po/ spyi bo'i tshangs bug k+ṣa dkar pos bkag par bsam/ steng rlung rngub cing rgyab rlung 'then la bum pa kha sbyor bya/ slar rlung gnyis ka gyen du ches cher drangs shing rlung mig sems gsum k+ṣa la gtad pas srog thur gyi rlung steng du 'ong bas lte ba'i āḥgayos gyen du spud pas dbu ma'i nang brgyud hūm̐ la thug pas hūm̐ phul nas gyen du 'phos nas spyi bo'i k+ṣa phul nas steng du thon la khad du bsam/

rlung ma thub pa'i tshe hūm̐ dang k+ṣa rang sar phab/ de 'dra thun re rer rlung drag po bum pa can sgang dri la nyer gcig re las mi nyung ba bsgom/ mthar bsngo ba bya/ 'byongs rtags spyi ltar 'byung*/ 'byongs nas thun rer ma brjed pa dran tsam re bya/ cher mi bsgom mo// las la sbyar ba ni/ 'chi bar shes shing dus la babs pa'i tshe thim rim rnams ngos bzung*/ yo byad la ma chags par dkon mchog gsum gyi phyogs su btang*/ 'pho ba'i dmigs pa sbyong ba'i skabs ltar yang yang gsal btab/ 'chi ba la thug pa'i tshe lus gnad tsog bu'am/ chos bdun nam seng ge'i nyal stabs sam/ grogs sogs kyis bskyor ba gang bde'i ngang nas rang lus yi dam gyi nang nas dbu ma thig le dang bcas gsal btab/ spyi bor 'dom gang tsam du rtsa ba'i bla ma mchog gsum 'dus pa'i bdag nyid yi dam gyi sku'i rnam par bsgom/ mchod cing 'chi ba lam du slong bar gsol ba btab/ dbang bzhi blang*/ rang la mi bsdu ba de nyid du gsal ba'i ngang nas (497)srog rtsol gyi rlung shin tu drag po stod du 'then pa'i ngang nas a hikra drag po bcu gcig brjod pas lte ba'i a gyen du drag por 'phos pas snying ga'i hūm̐ la bstim/ de ma thag rlung rtsol dang a hikra drag po bcu gcig gis rlung cher g.yos nas mgrin par slebs/ yang rlung dang a hikra drag po lnga brjod pas spyi bo'i k+ṣa la reg ma thag k+ṣa rang bzhin med par gsal nas hūm̐ tshangs bug tu thon par bsam/ slar rlung dang a hikra drag po mang du brjod pa hūm̐ skar mda' ltar song ba yi dam gyi thugs kar thim par bsam zhing rlung a hikra drag la mang bas 'pho/ rang gis ma nus na grogs kyis a hikra drag la mang bar brjod cing rang gis rlung dmigs la 'bad/ lus la phyi mig mi lta ba gnad che/ 'phos zin nas bla ma'i thugs dang rang sems dbyer med phyag rgya chen po'i ngang du bzhag go /gzhan la 'debs na'ang tshul de nyid man ngag gnad dang ldan par sbyar ro// tshul 'di ni ma bsgoms kyang dbang po rab 'bring tha ma gsum sku gsum du 'tshang rgya ba'i myur lam ma bsgoms sangs rgyas 'pho ba'i gdams pa zhes bya'o// drug pa lam gyi blo chod bar do'i gdams pa ni/

'chi ba'i rtags rnams ngos bzung nas 'chi ba la thug pa'i tshe chags zhen med cing 'chi ba la brod pa'i ngang nas rang lhar gsal ba'i spyi bor bla ma bsgom/ mchod nas bar do lam du slong bar gsol ba btab/ rang la bstim/ 'chi ba la thug pa'i tshe/ thog mar snang mched thob gsum thim pa ngos bzung*/ nyer thob 'od gsal la thim pa'i de ma thag 'od gsal ngos bzung zhing 'od gsal gyi ngang la mnyam par bzhag /'di la ji tsam sdod kyang rang dbang yod pas de'i ngang du grol bar bya/ de tsam mi nus na 'od gsal de'i ngang nas lha sku sgyu ma lta bur ldang ba'i sbyor ba bya/ de yang ma nus na bar do'i gdams pa 'di ltar nyams su (498)blangs te/ gang zag rab tshe 'dir 'od gsal phyag rgya chen po la 'dris pa dag gis bar dor 'jug bya dgags pa ni/ bdag shi ba dang gnas grogs lus sogs bar do yin par ngo shes par byas nas/ rang lha skur bsgoms la rjes gzhig gam ril 'dzin gang rung gis 'od gsal stong nyid phyag rgya chen po'i ngang du mnyam par gzhag pas mngal du 'jug bya khegs par 'gyur ro// de tsam mi nus pa'i gang zag 'bring tshe 'dir bskyed rim la 'dris pa dag gis bar dor rang nyid phor skye na pho la sdang zhing mo la chags pa dang*/ mor skye na de las log pa'i snang ba dang*/ pho mo 'du 'phrod byed pa mthong na de la chags sdang mig ser 'byung bas de'i tshe bdag sngon yang chags sdang byas pas 'khor bar 'khor ba yin/ da ni chags sdang mi bya'o snyam nas dran pas gsos btab/ des ma khegs na pho mo gnyis bla ma yab yum du bsgoms nas gsang ba'i dbang zhu bar bsam/ des kyang ma khegs na bla ma yi dam yab yum sogs snang srid 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad med bzhin du snang ba rmi lam sgyu ma lta bu yin mod/ sngon chad kyang de ltar ma rtogs pas 'khor bar 'khyams pa yin/ da ni yang dag pa'i bden pa 'khor 'das dbyer med rig grol rang shar gyi de kho na nyid 'di la mnyam par bzhag par bya'o snyam du blos bcad kyis nyams su blang*/

des bdun phrag dang por khegs par 'gyur/ bdun phrag phyi ma rnams su yang tshul de ltar 'bad pas mngal sgo khegs par tshegs med pa yin no// gang zag tha ma lam rim pa gnyis la goms pa chung ba dag gis mngal ma khegs pas mngal 'dam nas chos sgrub pa'i rten bzung ba ni/ bar dor gnas pa'i tshe sems can thams cad kyi don du bdag bar do 'di nas 'phos te sangs rgyas kyi zhing bde ba can la sogs par ci nas kyang skye ba'i nying mtshams sbyor bar bya'o snyam pa'i 'dun pa (499)drag pos mtshams sbyar ro// de tsam mi nus na bdag sems can gyi don nus pa'i rigs rnam par dag cing gtsang bar skye ba'i nying mtshams sbyor gyi ma dag pa rnams su mi skye'o snyam pa'i 'phen pa bya zhing*/ skabs 'dir ma'i mngal dngos su mi mthong bas 'jigs skrag gi snang bas 'bros par rtsom pas gnas ngan pa/ mi gtsang ba'i 'dam dang sa phug /gangs khung gcong rong la sogs pa gnas ngan skyugs bro ba rnams su mi 'gro bar lha khang mchod rten pho brang la sogs par 'gro bar brtsams pas mi'i lus rten chos sgrub nus pa rigs mtho zhing gtsang mar skye ba ste/ 'di ni nyams len tha ma bar dor lus ngan spang zhing*/ lus bzang po len pa'i thabs mngal gdams pa'i sbyor ba zhes bya ba ste bar dor grol ba'i gdams pa yin te/ 'di la yang goms pa sngon du 'gro dgos pas nyin mtshan gyi snang ba bar dor bsgoms nas/ rab 'od gsal/ 'bring sgyu lus/ tha ma mngal dgag pa/ de tsam mi nus kyang mngal 'dam pa'i sbyor ba/ blos byas kyi sgo nas sbyangs shing 'dris pas goms pa lta bur bya ba gal che'o// rjes ni dus thams cad du mnyam bzhag gi gtso bor gtum mo bsgom/ rjes thob sgyu lus kyi chos thams cad sgyu ma lta bur sbyang*/ mtshan mo gnyid 'thug 'od gsal dang bag chags rmi lam 'khrul par ldang na rmi lam sbyangs/ skabs su 'pho ba dang thun mtshams rnams su bar do sbyangs pas rab tshe 'di/

'bring 'chi ba'i tshe/ tha mas kyang bar dor mchog gi dngos grub zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang mi thob mi srid do// zhes pa ni zab lam nā ro'i chos drug mar lugs kyi gdams pa ma tshang ba med cing tshig mdor bsdus nas bshad pa'i skabs so/// /yang gnyis med dus kyi 'khor lo'i rdzogs rim kasmi ra sau ma (500)nā tha'i lugs sbyor ba yan lag drug pa la yang*/ thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i sngon 'gro sngar ltar la/ khyad par gyi sngon 'gro dben gsum ni/ lus ngag yid gsum 'jig rten dang mthun pa'i rnam g.yeng dang*/ chos kyi bskyed rim sngags dang chos spyod bsam gtan gang yang mi byed par khyab gdal du zo glod pa zhag bdun sogs bya'o// dngos gzhi la sbyor ba yan lag drug pa sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i rnal 'byor thog mtha' bar gsum du dge ba las/ dang po thog mar dge ba sku rdo rje'i rnal 'byor la sor bsam gnyis kyi/ dang po so sor sdud pa ni/ lus gnad rkang pa rdor skyil/ lag gnyis rdo rje khu tshur so sor bsgreng ba brla khud du kha sbub/ gzhan bsam gtan gyi yan lag spyi ltar la/ lta stangs rdo rje gtsug tor gyi lta ba zhes pa sna rtse nas sor nyi shu gyen du 'phags pa'i thad kyi bar snang la mig bsgrad nas/ rang dus 'khor dpa' bo gcig par bsam pas mun pa'i khang bur sems rab tu g.yo ba 'di mdun gyi lta stangs la gtad nas bsgrims te bsgom/ yang nyin mo bla gab med pa ni/ snga dro dang nub dang phyi dro shar du phyogs pas lus gnad lta stangs sgom tshul sogs gong ma lta bus res 'ga' mdun gyi nam mkha' sprin med pa la sems 'dzin/ res 'ga' mdun gyi ri rtse dang nam mkha'i mtshams su sems bzung*/ 'di dag gi tshe 'og rlung cung zad 'then no// de ltar yar nyin mtshan gnyis su bcad nas bsgoms pas du ba la sogs pa'i rtags bcu 'char/ gal te 'char dka' na spogs pa'i cho ga dang bying rgod na ba sogs byung na gegs sel rgyas pa sogs khrid gzhung na gsal lo// rtags bcu la mtshan ltas du ba/

smig rgyu/ nam mkha'/ mar me lta bu ste bzhi/ nyin ltas 'bar ba/ zla ba/ nyi ma/ rdo rje/ cha lang*/ thig le lta bu ste drug 'char (501)ro// des ni dbang po dang tshogs drug /rtsa ba dang yan lag gi rlung gis g.yos pas der 'dzin 'khrul blor 'phyan pa bkag cing*/ 'od lnga sgra gcan/ thig le thig phran sku dang yig 'bru phyag mtshan la sogs par snang ba'i rtags dang*/ rtags can bden tshig grub cing mchog sbyin nus pas/ 'di skabs shi na'ang lus bzang po blangs te/ lam gyi 'phro mthud pas skye ba bdun la sangs rgyas thob la mthar thug rdo rje sems gdan gsum tshang ba'i go 'phang 'grub par byed do/// /gnyis pa sor sdud kyi ngo bo brtan byed bsam gtan bsgom pa ni/ lus gnad snga ma lta bus bsam gtan lnga bsgom ste/ du sogs rtags gang rung mthong ba ni shes rab/ de la der 'dzin gyi 'khrul blo med par mngon sum du mthong ba rtogs pa/ stong gzugs de gcig nas du ma'i bar du shar yang 'dzin pa med pa dpyod pa/ phyi'i stong gzugs de rnams dang nang gi sems dbyer med du rtogs pa dga' ba/ dbyer med ro gcig gi rtags snang shar yang 'dzin med du 'jog cing byan tshud pa ni g.yo med kyi bde ba ste/ de ltar chos lnga pos gzugs sgra dri ro reg chos phyi nang gi tshogs drug stong gzugs thams cad tshul de lngas gnad du bsnun nas bsgom pa yin no// de la nyams myong skyes nas bogs 'don pa ni thabs sna tshogs kyi sgo nas 'don dgos te/ nyin mo sor sdud kyi skabs ltar nam mkha' stong par stong gzugs la sems 'dzin/ de rjes lta stangs dang stong gzugs mar phab nas mdun gyi ka ba sogs la sems bzung*/ las snang de dag dang stong gzugs kyang yul yul can dbyer med du ma rtogs kyi bar sbyang*/ mtshan mo sna bug gi rlung la sems gtad nas bsgom/ yang mtshan mo rang lha stong rar gsal ba'i khong dbus rtsa dbu ma sngon po yas (502)sne tshangs bug dang mas sne gsang gnas su slebs pa/

g.yas su ro ma dmar po g.yon du rkyang ma dkar po gnyis/ yas sne sna bug dang mas sne dbu mar 'dus pa'i mar sne 'dus mtshams su sems gtad la bsgom/ sgom tshul gyi yan lag lnga bsam gtan gyi dus ltar bya/ sna bug gi rlung la sems gtad pa'i tshe rlung gi kha dog mthong tshe kha dog dang mthun pa'i las 'grub pa'i smon lam btab na gang btab 'grub par gsungs so// yang rang lus tha mal pa'i spu dkar nag mtshams su rlung sems ma yengs par gtad/ bde drod skyes tshe mdun tu ri mo nag po la sems gtad nas bsgoms pas rtsa dbus mthong*/ de nas rim gyis rtsa 'khor rnams mthong*/ mthar gsang sngags kyi chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis shes par 'gyur te sa dang po'i bden pa mthong ba yin no// de nas 'od gsal dang bsres nas bogs 'don pa ni/ gnyid khar lus gnad sogs sngar ltar gyis mdun gyi stong gzugs la rlung mig sems gsum gtad/ gnyid la 'gro khar rlung mig sems gsum sna rtser phab la dar cig bsgom pas brtan par 'gyur ba dang lus gnad bkrol nas seng ge'i nyal stabs kyi gnyid log pas 'od gsal mthug srab gang rung zin par 'gyur ro// zin pa'i tshe sngar ltar bsam gtan gyi yan lag lngas nyams su blang ngo*// thun mtshams su bsre bas bogs dbyung ba ni/ bde sdug bar ma'i nad gdon la sogs pa ci byung yang 'od gsal stong pa nyid las ma g.yos bzhin du bsam gtan gyi yan lag lngas gnad du bsnun la bsgom mo// de ltar 'bad pas stong gzugs thams cad 'od gsal nyid du ro mnyam zhing*/ rtags ni stong gzugs rnams phra 'tsher 'dar gzhig dka' ba 'od sna tshogs 'phro ba ste mtshan nyid lnga ldan du 'byung*/ rang sems rnam rtog gi (503)mtshan 'dzin thams cad dang bral ba'i gsal stong zung 'jug gis dus 'da' ba 'byung ngo*// yon tan ni lha'i mig sogs sngon gnas dran pa gzhan sems shes pa 'chi 'pho ba rtogs pa ste mngon shes lnga dang*/

mthar thug gdan gsum tshang ba'i sangs rgyas mi bskyod rdo rje'i go 'phang 'grub pa'o/// /de nas bar du dge ba gsung rdo rje'i rnal 'byor la srog 'dzin gnyis las/ dang po srog rtsol ni/ de yang rgyud sde gzhan gyi lugs la sna bug gi rlung g.yas srog g.yon rtsol ba zhes bshad kyang*/ 'dir sna bug gnyis ka'i rlung ni srog yin la de gnad du bsnun pa la 'bad pa rtsol ba zhes dgongs so// dus ni stong gzugs rnams brtan par mthong nas sna bug gi rlung mnyam rgyu stong gzugs ma 'gags kyi bar du yin no// de yang mun khang du lus gnad smin mtshams nas gyen du sor bco brgyad kyi mtshams su gtad/ rkang pa g.yas bskums pa'i rting pas gsang rtsa gnyis mnan/ g.yon de'i mdun tu bzhag /lag pa ni bsnol nas brla steng du bzhag pa dang*/ khu tshur bcang ba'i snying gar bsnol ba gnyis gang bde bya'o// nyams len ni drug las/ thog mar rdor bzlas kyis rtsa lam sbyang ba ni/ srog gi rlung rngubs pa oṃ sku rdo rje/ gnas pa hūm̐ thugs rdo rje/ dbyung ba āḥgasung rdo rje/ dbyung ba hūm̐ du gsungs kyang 'dir de las go log pa ni 'di ka'i khyad chos su gsung*/ rlung rdor bzlas kyi skabs sems rlung la gtad cing*/ de yang bsam gtan gyi skabs ltar yan lag lngas nyams su blang ngo*// de 'byongs nas 'jam rlung dgang stong gi sbyor bas/ srog dbu mar 'dzud pa ni/ rlung mnyam rgyu'i dus bya bas mnyam rgyur mi 'dug na yon po srong ba'i 'khrul 'khor gyis mnyam rgyur bcug nas/ rlung ro bus shing rngubs nas sbyor ba bzhi ldan la rgyun ring du bzung (504)zhing sems bsam gtan gyi yan lag lnga bya'o// de tshud nas/ rtsub rlung bum can gyis srog dbu mar 'ching ba ni/ dgu phrugs su bus la sna gnyis nas rngub cing dgang ba dang lhan cig rgyab rlung drag pas bsdam nas bum pa kha sbyor gyis yun ring du bzung zhing sems gong ltar bya'o// des srog dbu mar tshud cing chings pa'i rtags srog gi rgyu ba mi mngon par bum pa can je ring la song nas srog 'gags shing rnam rtog rgyun chad par 'byung ngo*// de gnyis kas ma tshud mchings ni/

drag rlung btsan thabs kyis nyi zla'i lam 'gog pa ni/ lus gnad gong ltar las lag pas rba rlabs 'ching ba thog mar gcig nas mthar brgya stong gi bar du je mang bcings pas dang por 'khrul snang 'char/ de'i tshe bsam gtan gyi yan lag lngas gnad du bsnun pas mthar spros bral bde stong 'od gsal sgyu ma lta bur 'char ba ni gnad zab pa'i mthar thug pa ste lag len zhal la dris shig /'di'i las phran btsan thabs kyi 'pho ba ni/ rang lhar gsal ba'i khong par rtsa dbu ma lte ba yan chad ljang gu/ de man sngon po yas sne tshangs bug dang mas sne gsang gnas su zug pa'i lte ba'i thad du dmar cha a thung bshos bu zur gsum pa'i dbyibs can nas tsam pa dang*/ spyi bor dkar cha mtho gang zur bstan/ snying gar sems kyi ngo bo hūm̐ nag po bsam/ thog mar rlung sbyangs nas steng rlung rngubs nas mnan pa'i tshe haṃ zhu nas snying ga'i hūm̐ la thim/ rgyab rlung drag tu 'then pas lte ba'i a shad yar 'phos hūm̐ la thim/ rba rlabs bcings nas hūm̐ sbar bas rlung sems tha mi dad tshangs bug tu thon par bsam/ sbyangs pa'i tshe tshangs bug rdo rje rgya gram gyis bcad nas hūm̐ tshangs bug nas yar mi 'don par dmigs/ ngal gso dus srog gtong bas yi ge gsum po rang sar bab par bsam/ 'byongs rtag (505)spyi dang 'dra/ las sbyor ni 'chi ba'i dus la bab na rgya gram bsal hūm̐ nam mkhar 'phar rba rlabs drag la yun ring bar bcings/ mthar dbyings rig bsres bas mchog 'grub par 'gyur ro// de ltar bkag pas 'og sgo 'gags na/ srog rlung steng du btang bas grol ba ni dri chen 'gags na sna bug g.yon bkag g.yas nas srog drag tu rngubs la lte bar mnan/ mi thub pa'i tshe g.yas bkag g.yon du drag pos btang bas grol/ dri chu 'gags na de las go ldog la nyams su blang bas grol/ 'di'i 'phros don srog rlung gi sbyor bas las mang du 'grub pa ni kho bos bgyis pa'i khrid che bar gsal lo// 'di'i rjes su bskyed rim dang bsdu rim gyi dkyil 'khor bcu 'gags pa ni yan lag yin pas ma bris so// des ni las rlung thams cad ye shes kyi rlung 'ba' zhig tu rgyu zhing 'gags la/

rtags ni rang gi mdzod spu sha lpags 'phrig cing za ba dang g.ya' ba 'byung*/ spyi bor mi bzod pa'i tsha tshag dang stong gzugs thams cad ches cher gsal zhing 'bar ba 'byung ngo*// rtags can byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis rang nyid la mchod pa byed par 'gyur ro// des ni gdan gsum tshang ba'i sangs rgyas don yod grub pa'i go 'phang myur du 'grub pa gdon mi za'o/// /gnyis pa srog rtsol spyir sa pas rlung sems dbu mar tshud pa de nyid rtsa 'khor rnams su 'dzin pa'i phyir 'dzin pa'i rnal 'byor la/ sngon 'gro srog thur bsre ba ni/ rlung yon po srong ba'i 'khrul 'khor gyi bcos nas mnyam rgyur byung ba'i tshe/ hūm̐ zhes ring pos srog phyir bus nas/ nang du ma rngub pa'i ngang nas hūm̐ zhes thung ngus thur sel drag tu 'then cing rgya mtsho ri rab la sbyar ba grangs mang du bya/ de ltar mang du byas pas thur sel (506)dbang du 'dus rtags pho smad sbom zhing khregs 'byung*/ de'i tshe srog steng nas drangs pa kha sbyar ba yun ring du sbyang ngo*// dngos gzhi bum pa can dus kyi gnas drug tu bcings pa 'dzin pa'i dngos gzhi ni/ rang lhar gsal ba'i khong par rtsa gsum kha dog sngar lta bu la dbu ma'i yar sne gtsug tor nas mdun du dgug pa smin mtshams dang mar sne gsang gnas su mdun du rdo rje'i bu gar zug pa khu ba 'bab pa/ ro rkyang gnyis yar sne sna bug gnyis su zug pa ro ma'i mar sne lte 'og nas mdun tu 'khyogs pa rdo rje zug pa dri chu 'bab pa/ rkyang ma'i mar sne lte 'og nas rgyab tu 'khyogs pa dri chen 'bab pa/ rtsa gsum 'dus mtshams lte bar sa khams kyi 'khor lo rtsa 'dab drug cu bzhi pa/ snying gar chu khams kyi rtsa 'dab nang rim bzhi dang phyi rim brgyad/ mgrin par me khams nang rim brgyad dang phyi rim bcu drug de'i phyi so gnyis/ dpral bar rlung khams nang rim bzhi dang phyi rim brgyad de'i phyi bcu drug

/gtsug tor nam mkha'i khams sngon po tshangs bug las sor gcig gi 'og tu 'dab ma bzhi/ gsang gnas su ye shes kyi khams ljang gu 'dab ma nang rim pa bcu dang phyi rim bcu drug rnams gsal gdab/ lus gnad sngar rdor bzlas kyi skabs ltar byas nas hūm̐ ring gis srog phyir bus nas rngubs pa'i gong du hūm̐ thung gis thur sel yar rngub/ slar srog dal bus rngubs nas dgang zhing lce ya rkan la sbyar zhing mig gyen tu bsgrad nas bum can gsum nas brgya'i bar gang thub bzung ba'i ring rlung sems lte ba'i rtsa 'khor la ma yengs par bzung ba'i mthar lte ba'i rtsa 'khor lo 'od du zhu nas snying ga'i rtsa 'khor la thim par bsam pa ni lte ba'i bum can no// yang hūm̐ ring thung sogs gong ltar bum can dang rlung sems snying gar bzung ba'i mthar snying ga'i rtsa 'khor 'od du zhu ba mgrin pa'i rtsa 'khor (507)la thim pa ni snying ga'i bum can no// yang hūm̐ ring thung bum can sogs sngar ltar rlung sems mgrin par bzung rjes mgrin pa'i rtsa 'khor la bstim pa ni mgrin pa'i bum can no// yang hūm̐ ring thung bum can sogs sngar lar gyis dpral bar rlung sems bzung rjes dpral ba'i rtsa 'khor lo 'od du zhu ba gtsug tor gyi rtsa 'khor la bstim pa ni dpral ba'i bum can no// yang hūm̐ ring thung bum can rlung sems sogs sngar ltar gtsug tor du bzung rjes gtsug tor gyi rtsa 'khor 'od du zhu ba gsang gnas kyi rtsa 'khor la bstim pa ni gtsug tor gyi bum can no// yang hūm̐ ring thung bum can rlung sems sogs sngar ltar gsang gnas su bzung rjes gsang gnas kyi rtsa 'khor lo 'od du zhu ba hūm̐ nag por gyur pa dbu ma'i nang nas yar phyung ba snying gar slebs pa 'od lngar gyur pas rang lus rtsa gsum dang bcas pa 'od du mer mer 'bar ba la shes pa gtad nas bum can ci thub bzung ba'i mthar 'od lnga 'ja' yal ba ltar dmigs med du ci gnas su bzhag go

/'di'i skabs bde ba g.yo ches pa na dmigs pa dang 'khrul 'khor gyis spogs pa sogs ni kho bos bgyis pa'i sbyor drug gi khrid yig che bar gsal ba ltar bya'o// de nas bcud len gyi mchog lce gsum pa skyod pas nang gi bdud rtsi 'thung ba ni lus gnad sor sdud kyi skabs ltar la/ tshangs bug gi thad klad rgya'i steng du zla dkyil mthe bong tsam pa'i lte bar byang sems kyi rang bzhin nu ma'i dbyibs can bdud rtsi 'dzag la khad pa'i mthar dbyangs bcu drug gis bskor bar bsam/ mchu cung zad gdangs nas hūm̐ ring gis srog bus/ hūm̐ thung gis thur sel drang drangs / slar srog kha sna gsum ga nas rngubs nas bkang bas rang byung gi gtum mo'i drod rlung gis bskul bas dkar cha nu ma lta bu dbyangs yig dang bcas pa bdud rtsi skya nur gyis (508)bab pa ya rkan gyi lce'u chung brgyud nas babs pa gzhibs pas lus thams cad bdud rtsis gang nas bsam gtan zag med kyi bde bas myos shing tshim par bsam nas lces lce'u chung bskul zhing gzhibs pas dang por mchil ma 'bab mthar ro mngar ba dang bcas pa babs/ myong bas bcud len thams cad kyi mchog yin par rgyud nas gsungs so// de ltar 'dzin pa bum can drug bsgoms pas rtags tshad ni/ sngar gyi stong gzugs rnams nyams myong dang 'dres zhing cher gsal ba dang*/ gzhom du med pa'i gzugs sgra dri ro reg chos la longs spyod pa/ srog thur 'dres pas ye shes kyi gtum mo'i yon tan mngon tu 'gyur/ bza' rgyu ri rab tsam zos kyang 'ju la/ til 'bru tsam ma zos kyang bkres skom gyi snang ba mi 'byung*/ mthar gdan gsum tshang ba'i sangs rgyas rin chen 'byung ldan gyi go 'phang mngon du byed pa yin no// bum can drug gi skabs rtsa 'khor drug gi dmigs pa dang rlung dang stong gzugs snang ba gsum dbyer med bsal bzhag med pa de 'dzin bral zhing lhan skyes su nyams su blang ba la rnam gsum ro gcig bzhis tha snyad mdzad do// gsum pa tha mar dge ba thugs rdo rje'i rnal 'byor la rjes dran dang ting 'dzin gnyis las/

dang po rjes su dran pa'i rnal 'byor ni/ sngon tu sbyangs pa'i stong gzugs dang nyams myong ji snyed pa rnams phyag rgya gsum gyi gdams pas bogs 'don zhing yon tan 'phel bar byed pa yin pas de yang rnal 'byor pa'i khams sla ba dang ska ba dang shin tu ska ba'i dbye bas phyag rgya gsum du gsungs pa las thog mar khams sla ba'i gang zag gis dman pa las kyi phyag rgya bsten pa ni/ srog rtsol rtsa rlung sbyang ba'i phyir bzhugs stangs gsum dang thig le sbyang ba'i phyir 'khrul 'khor drug /dngos gzhi rang lus gzhan lus thabs ldan gnyis sogs ni (509)'dir ma bshad pas rtogs par 'dod na kho bos bgyis pa'i sbyor drug gi khrid yig rnam 'byed shing rtar bshad pa ltar bya'o// khams ska ba'i gang zag gi gtum mo btags pa'i phyag rgya nyams su blangs te/ rang lhar gsal ba'i khong par rtsa gsum gyi 'khyogs tshul 'dzin pa'i skabs ltar gsal ba'i lte bar rtsa 'dab bdun cu rtsa gnyis pa'i lte bar gtum mo'i me hoḥyig mtshan nyid bzhi ldan dang*/ dbu ma'i yar sne mdzod spu'i phyogs su thig le dkar po mthe bong tsam zhig dbu la chu ltar 'dril bar bsam/ hūm̐ ring thung gis srog thur bum can du bkang bas lte ba'i hoḥlas ye shes kyi me 'bar bas dbu ma'i nang brgyud thig la reg pas byang sems babs pas dpral bar dga' ba/ mgrin par mchog dga'/ snying gar dga' bral/ lte bar lhan skyes la mnyam par bzhag /slar srog rtsol gyis sbar bas byang sems me dang 'dres pas gyen du log pa lte bar dga' ba/ snying gar mchog dga'/ mgrin par dga' ba la/ dpral bar lhan skyes/ mthar dmar cha'i me dang dkar cha'i rgyun 'dres pas gtsug tor nas rkang mthil yan ba spu'i khung bu tshun dkar dmar 'dres pas khrig mer gang bas bde drod kyi ye shes cher 'bar bas rnam rtog tshogs drug gi snang ba thams cad shi nas bde chen mi rtog pa'i ngang du brgyal ba yun ring du bsgom pa'o/

khams shin tu ska ba'i gang zag gis gdams ngag gi phyag rgya nyams su blang ba ni/ rang dus 'khor yum dang kha sbyor gyi'i lhan skyes sgrub thabs ltar gsal ba'i yab kyi dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ nag po/ lte bar hoḥser po/ gtsug tor du swā ljang gu/ gsang bar hā sngon po bsam/ mkha' gsang byin rlabs sgrub thabs (510)ltar phyis nas yab kyi khong par rtsa gsum dpral mgrin snying lte gsang ba'i 'khor lo lnga gsal btab/ snyoms 'jug byas pas dpral ba'i 'khor lo nas byung sems babs pa dga' ba/ snying gar mchog dga'/ lte bar dga' bral/ gsang bar lhan skyes su mnyam par bzhag /ches bsrubs pa'i tshe nor bu'i rtse mor son pa 'phor nye ba na hūm̐ ring thung sogs srog rtsol gyi rlung bum can 'dzin pa'i skabs lta bus bzung zhing bzlog pas lte bar dga' ba/ snying gar mchog dga'/ mgrin par dga' bral/ dpral bar lhan skyes su mnyam par bzhag /mthar bde stong lhan skyes kyi rang zhal bzo bral brjod med kyi bde ba dang rnam kun mchog ldan gyi stong pa gnyis zung 'jug tu 'jog pa ni phyag rgya chen mo ste/ 'di ni gong gi phyag rgya gsum ga'i nyams len la sbyar ba shin tu gal che'o// de ltar phyag rgya gsum la 'bad pas rtags tshad ni/ sa bcu rnam par dag pas rtags bcu'i stong gzugs shin tu brtan pa dang*/ gnas skabs bcu'i dri ma dag /rtags snang ni/ rang gi lus lhar gsal ba las 'od 'phros pas nam mkha'i khams gang zhing rang lus 'od kyi nang du tshud pa thim pa sogs 'byung*/ mthar gdan gsum tshang ba'i sangs rgyas 'od dpag med kyi go 'phang nges par 'grub pa'o/// /gnyis pa ting nge 'dzin gyi rnal 'byor ni/ lus gnad rnam snang chos bdun dang ldan pas/ rlung gnad ni/ ma ning gi rlung zhes bya ba srog thur gnyis ka rtsol ba spong nas rang sor bzhag la/ sems kyi bsam gtan ni/

dus zhabs snyan brgyud las// sgom pa dmigs bcas stong gzugs dang*// dmigs med bde ba ro mnyam las// sems ni mi g.yo brtan par gnas// dngos po thams cad bder (511)'chor ro// zhes gsungs so// sngar gyi sor sdud dang bsam gtan gyi skabs su mthong ba'i stong gzugs rnams snang stong*/ srog rtsol dang 'dzin pa'i dus shar ba'i shes pa gsal stong*/ rjes dran gyi dus nyams su myong ba'i myong ba ni bde stong de thams cad ro gcig tu 'dres pa'i ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par bzhag go /de yang 'dres pa zhes rgyu mi gcig la chu dang 'o ma 'dris pa lta bu ma yin pa/ rgyu gcig pa chu gnyis bsres pa lta bu yang ma yin pa/ bde ba dang bral ba'i stong pa phyal chad/ stong pa dang bral ba'i stong pa skyid 'dod/ gsal ba dang bral ba'i stong pa med dgag /stong pa dang bral ba'i gsal snang rtag lta la sogs pa phyag rdzogs dbu gsum gyi lam gyis ma bslad pa'i rnam kun mchog ldan gzhom med don dam pa'i dus kyi 'khor lo gsal bzhag spang ba'i ngang du gdod nas grub pa la der 'dzin gyi 'dzin stong med par mnyam par 'jog pa ni don gyi snying po rdzogs rim gyi rtsa ba nyams len gyi nying khu kho na yin no// de ltar bsgoms pas rtags tshad ni lus sems snang cha tshogs drug thams cad bde stong gnyis med du 'char ba sogs rtags snang thams cad lkog gyur du ma lus pa rnal 'byor pa'i mngon sum tshad grub tu nyams su myong ba sogs thun mong gi yon tan mtha' dag thob/ mthar thug rtsa rlung thig le thams cad ye shes rdo rje'i ngo bor dag pas gdan gsum tshang ba'i sangs rgyas rnam par snang mdzad chen po'i ngo bor 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur ro// de ltar yan lag drug po bsgoms pas rnal 'byor pa rab sngon bsags dang ldan pas ni zla ba gsum tshun la mchog 'grub cing*/ tha ma skal pa dman pas bar do tshun la mchog 'grub la/

skal pa 'bring dag gis ni/ lo gsum dang zla ba gsum (512)la 'bad pas bsgoms pas zhag re la rlung nyi khri chig stong drug brgya re 'gyur ba rnams lo gsum phyogs gsum la nyin zhag phrugs stong phrag gcig dang nyis brgya bdun cu tham pa 'byung ba'i ring*/ nyin mtshan g.yel med rtse gcig tu nyams su blang ba'i tshe/ zhag grangs de rnams kyi ring bde stong lhan skyes byang chub kyi sems rlung dang tha mi dad pa zag bcas 'jig rten pa'i bde ba las 'das pa dag gis gsang gnas kyi 'khor lo phyed gang ba'i tshe sa dang po thob/ ril por gang bas sa gnyis pa// lte ba'i phyed gang bas sa gsum pa// ril por gang bas sa bzhi pa// snying ga'i phyed gang bas sa lnga pa// ril por gang bas sa drug pa// mgrin pa'i phyed gang bas sa bdun pa/ ril por gang bas sa brgyad pa/ dpral ba'i phyed gang bas sa dgu pa/ ril por gang bas sa bcu pa/ gtsug tor gyi phyed gang bas sa bcu gcig pa/ ril por gang bas bcu gnyis pa/ lus thams cad gang bas bcu gsum pa thob bo// rtsa ba'i rlung lnga/ yan lag gis rlung stong dang brgyad brgya/ khams so gnyis/ rtsa nyi khri dgu 'bum/ cha bcu drug la sogs pa dag nas rnam kun mchog ldan rnam med rnam pa can gyi rang gzugs sku drug yongs su rdzogs pa khyab bdag dang po'i sangs rgyas dus kyi 'khor lo'i go 'phang thob par byed pa ni mi bslu ba yang dag pa'i tshad ma yin no// zhes bya ba rdzogs rim thams cad kyi mthar thug sbyor ba yan lag drug pa'i skabs so// de ltar bla med lhan skyes rnam bzhi'i rdzogs rim shin tu bsdus pa ste/ deng sang dus snyigs ma lnga bdo zhing mi rnams tshe thung ba dang shes rab dman pas yig cha dang dmigs pa ches mang na blo gros kyi khyon chung ngur mi shong ba'i nyes pa 'gogs pa dang*/ rang nyid kyang rnam g.yeng gi dbang dang blo gros (513)dman zhing sngon bsags kyi skal pa'i phul ches cher zhen pas brjed ngas kyi dran pa gso ba'i phyir/

rdo rje theg pa'i lam gyi snying po rnams legs par thos shing 'doms par byas nas/ slar rdzogs rim 'di rnams lung rigs 'phros don gyi spros pa bsgyungs shing dmigs pa rnams kyang gtso che ba med mi rung ba rnams bsdus/ de dag kyang sa bcad tho tsam ma gtogs tshig tshogs shin tu nyung bar bgyis pa 'di yang*/ dus mtha'i rdo rje 'dzin pa 'bri gung pa chos kyi grags pas me mo glang lo nag pa can gyi phyogs snga ma'i rdzogs pa gsum pa rgyal bas dpal ldan 'bras spungs kyi mchod rten chen por shākya zla ba bzang po la mchog gi dang po'i sangs rgyas kyi rgyud chen gsungs pa'i dus dge bar sbyar ba yin gyi/ lam la brtson pa lhur byed pa dag gis ni 'di tsam la nan tan bgyis pas kyang rdo rje 'chang chen po 'grub pa gdon mi za la/ yang lung rigs tshig don rgyas pa la mos pa dag gis ni 'di rnams rtsa bar byas te mtha' gcod rang rang gi khrid yig chen mo rnams dang*/ rgyud gzhung 'grel pa dang bcas pa rnams su rtogs par byos shig /ces pa yang 'bri dam pa chos phyug gi klung pho brang bkra shis tshugs kyi re'u mig lcang lo can rdo rje theg pa'i gan mdzod du bris pa'i yi ge pa ni bka' 'bangs kyi yang tha 'phyong rgyas grags pa dbang pos bgyis pa ste 'dis sems can thams cad la sman par gyur cig /shu bham+mastu sarba dza ga tam/ sarba pak+ṣe badz+ra yā na shā sa no da ya puṣ+ṭiṃ kurban+tu//(514)
